sales.title: BBVA–AMEX sales capture
sales.summary: A centralized service for processing high sales volumes and integrating with multiple financial modules.
sales.detail: The challenge was to process 16,000 records in three minutes without compromising flexibility or traceability. I built the service core with Spring Boot and GraphQL, plus an Apollo Federation API Gateway to centralize access from related processes. After evaluating multiple approaches, the solution achieved the target performance.

kafka.title: Kafka transaction platform
kafka.summary: An event-driven architecture to receive, transform, and distribute bank transactions in near real time.
kafka.detail: The solution evolved batch processing of up to 20 million daily transactions into a continuous flow. I integrated CDC and Oracle GoldenGate with Informix and Oracle, and implemented a jPOS producer for ISO 8583 messages with Spring Boot consumers routing operations by institution, reaching up to 1,000 transactions per second.

brimmerWeb.title: Colegio Brimmer website
brimmerWeb.summary: The school's public site — designed, built, and maintained solo, from requirements with staff to deployment.
brimmerWeb.detail: I designed and built Colegio Brimmer's public website end to end as a freelance project: gathered requirements directly with teachers and administrative staff, structured the content for parents and applicants, and implemented a responsive frontend with Vue, Vite, and JavaScript. The site is live at colegiobrimmer.edu.mx and remains the school's main web presence.

etl.title: ETL modernization with Spring Batch
etl.summary: Migration of Informix-based ETL processes to a modern, maintainable Spring Batch model.
etl.detail: I worked on migrating ETLs running on Informix to a processing architecture built with Spring Batch. This evolution modernized the existing processes, introduced a clearer execution structure, and established a more maintainable technology foundation for future development.

qa.title: QA test automation
qa.summary: Frontend and backend test automation with SmartBear, Selenium, and JUnit.
qa.detail: I developed an automation strategy centered primarily on SmartBear and complemented by Selenium and JUnit. The solution automated frontend test flows and validated backend components, reducing repetitive manual work and strengthening regression coverage.

brimmerPos.title: Brimmer Café — school POS
brimmerPos.summary: A full point-of-sale for the school cafeteria: sales at the register, cash sessions, credit accounts, and admin dashboards.
brimmerPos.detail: Designed and built the cafeteria's POS end to end, live at cafeteria.colegiobrimmer.edu.mx: catalog and checkout with scanner support and keyboard shortcuts, cash opening and closing with reconciliation, credit accounts and payments, inventory with kardex, and an admin dashboard with charts. The interface runs in light and dark themes over a documented design system — 48px targets, AA contrast in both themes — built for fast, accessible use by non-technical staff.
